name: Improvement Notice Drafter
notes: Officers pick a sample inspection, choose findings and get an AI or template draft Food Act improvement notice to edit, check, copy, draft in Outlook or download; legislative references now always come from the page's sample library, not AI, and must be confirmed against the approved LCC template. Reviewed for the brief and manager ready.
desc: Turns food safety inspection findings into a draft Food Act improvement notice with plain-English actions, dates to comply and automatic checks. The officer edits, confirms and copies or downloads the draft.
tested: Playwright at 1280x800 light and 390x844 dark: review, template draft, days validation, check and finish, confirm and mark ready, Copy notice text with Draft in Outlook link, sample ready notice, Start blank with add-finding validation, Steps to productionise panel, All AI prototypes button, focus outline, no horizontal scroll, no page or console errors. AI path with a stand-in: names, address, licence, email and phone replaced by placeholders in the prompt; bad AI fields (non-strings, days over default, invented reference) fall back to the template; Stop and use template works straight away; no dashes in visible text.
